job.job_description:
We're hiring a Generative AI Engineer (Fresher) to assist in building and deploying AI-powered applications using modern large language models and generative technologies. You will work on developing intelligent systems such as chatbots, content generators, and automation tools that leverage cutting-edge AI models.


Roles Responsibilities

Assist in developing and fine-tuning generative AI models using frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or OpenAI APIs
Work with large language models (LLMs) for text, image, or code generation tasks
Perform data preprocessing, cleaning, and annotation for AI model training
Support prompt engineering and optimization for better AI outputs
Collaborate with senior AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into applications
Test and evaluate model performance, accuracy, and efficiency
Document model behavior, training processes, and results
Stay updated with advancements in generative AI and emerging tools


Requirements

This position is ideal for someone passionate about AI, eager to learn, and interested in building practical applications using modern AI tools and frameworks.


Skills

TensorFlow
PyTorch
OpenAI APIs
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Data preprocessing
Data annotation
Prompt engineering
Model evaluation
Documentation
